description: This file defines the EverynetProvider class, which implements the LoraProvider interface. It provides methods to extract device ID, payload, and message type from LoRaWAN messages specifically formatted for the Everynet platform, and defines related constants and properties.

classes.name: EverynetProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider with API for Everynet, implementing methods to parse and handle messages specific to Everynet's format.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the URL path prefix for Everynet-specific API endpoints.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type this provider accepts, which is JSON.

methods.name: acceptedHttpMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method this provider expects, which is POST.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID (EUI) from the provided JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload string from the provided JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines the message type (uplink or unknown) based on the 'type' field.
